title: Length of Longest Subarray With at Most K Frequency

constraints.impact: O(n²) is about 10¹⁰ steps: far too slow. You need O(n) or O(n log n).

constraints.meaning: Values are positive but can be very large.
constraints.impact: A counting array of size 10⁹ is impossible, so the counts go in a hash map. This is also why there is no C version.

constraints.meaning: k is at least 1, so any single element is a good subarray on its own.
constraints.impact: The answer is always at least 1. No special case for 'no good subarray'.

constraints.meaning: The elements must sit next to each other.
constraints.impact: Contiguous + longest + a rule that every window must follow → sliding window.

bruteForce.summary: try every start i, extend j to the right with a fresh count map until some value goes over k. O(n²) time, which is too slow for n = 10⁵.
